neighbours.label: a split-off letter 'l'/'L' as its own token at the start of an uncommon word (Ver|l|autbarung, l|illois, L|aut)

notes: Very high-magnitude late-layer pole (max 268). The + pole also fires on l-pieces (l|imestones, л|ичную), so the distinction between the poles is unclear; this tests the - pole's top examples' pattern.
